header.title: SSSS April Newsletter
header.description: HELLO SOSY!!! Spring is here and so is final season, best of luck to everyone we are almost done!!

sections.subheader: It was a busy month for the SSSS, featuring Board Game Night, the SAP Office Tour, Terrariums, and a Coffee Chat with Nick Sumner!
text: Thanks to everyone who joined us, we hope you had fun! And we’re excited to see you at our upcoming events!!!

Nominations are open between now and 17 April 2026 at 11:59 PM. Please send your nominations to softwaresystems.council@sfss.ca with the following information: Your full name,  SFU computing ID, Position of choice, A blurb/speech on why you should be chosen
More information is available in our constitution https://drive.google.com/file/d/17VC184yvJ8EuUwU8XShSusroXgQDhH8Y/view?usp=sharing
More information in the SSSS Discord and if you have any questions please reach out to Matthew at softwaresystems.council@sfss.ca!
Need a place to focus? Stop by the First Years Study Hall to prep for finals, wrap up group projects, and grab some yummy snacks!
The last event of the term 😍 Come hang out and celebrate the end of finals with us 🥳
This event is organized by FAS, if you RSVP'd look out for a confirmation email from them soon!

sections.subheader: Thursday, April 16th 5:30PM on Discord, Thursday, April 30th 5:30PM SRYE 5050
text: As the 2025-2026 executive terms come to an end, come and see what the SSSS has been up to this year and what we plan to do in the future!!

signature.name: Jaycie Say
signature.endingNote: that's all folks! see you next month :)
